## Descripción
Welcome to the challenge! In this challenge, you will explore a web application and find an endpoint that exposes a file containing a hidden flag.

The application is a simple blog website where you can read articles about various topics, including an article about API Documentation. Your goal is to explore the application and find the endpoint that generates files holding the server’s memory, where a secret flag is hidden. The website is running [picoCTF News](http://chatelaine.cylabacademy.net:18694/).

Explore backend development with us

The head was dumped.
## solución
Dirigirnos a #APIDocumentation
![[Pasted image 20261002231231.png]]
En la pagina a la que nos redirige, bajamos hasta el final.
![[Pasted image 20261002231411.png]]
![[Pasted image 20261002231501.png]]
Damos en GET.
![[Pasted image 20261002231532.png]]
Y Try it out... y ejecutamos
![[Pasted image 20261002231618.png]]
![[Pasted image 20261002231746.png]]
